quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change the normal driving route. Be ready to follow a new path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there are multiple lanes for turning left. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white rectangles with black markings. You must obey them. This sign means passing other vehicles is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you to watch for bicycles crossing.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Stay alert for children when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter. It is posted at the end of one-way streets. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, 35 mph or slower is recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, 35 mph or slower is recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a curve ahead. It recommends driving at 35 mph or slower through the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you to a bridge ahead with narrow lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to wait for the left turn signal before turning left.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road is crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is approaching from the left.
Right lane ends ahead, merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead, merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and let other vehicles go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let other traffic pass if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let other traffic pass if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down as you approach an intersection with this sign and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if other cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Carefully drive through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let vehicles and pedestrians in or entering the intersection go first. You may go again when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. From this lane, you can either turn right or continue straight ahead at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging in from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging in from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will be entering from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign warns drivers to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians pass first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are driving over a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a barrier or median between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully in wet conditions.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork ahead.
Slow down because the road ahead turns sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead turns sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has a sharp turn. Slow down before you reach the sharp curve, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the highest speed you are allowed to drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the bridge or overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way. This is dangerous. You should turn around carefully.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black symbols. They alert you to road conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This eight-sided sign means you must stop at the intersection. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that lanes ahead are moving. Follow the new lane direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or deal with cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Get ready for a sharp left turn.
Watch for people crossing the road.
Take a detour to avoid unsafe driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid unsafe driving conditions.
questions.explanation: These signs tell you the traffic pattern or route will change ahead due to work zones. Follow the detour signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes going opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not go through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a detour is coming in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you an extra lane is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign is posted in parking lots for reserved spaces. These spaces are for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns drivers to drive carefully when the pavement is wet. Wet roads make vehicles harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you to keep to the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed to drive when exiting a highway. For example, it might show 30 mph.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, move to another lane if it is safe. This makes room for vehicles entering the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Work zones are dangerous for drivers and construction workers. Orange signs warn you about construction. This sign tells you that penalties are higher if you break traffic rules in a work zone.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other vehicles go first. Give them the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and stay farther away from the car in front of you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead. Be alert and watch for them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross the road. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles may cross or ride next to traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you to follow a different route because the normal road is closed for work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must do. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Wrong-way traffic on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wrong-way traffic on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you cannot enter from your current direction. The road is one-way traffic only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a divider between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers they must not drive slower than the posted speed. The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you to be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you of low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that hospital emergency services are located to the right.

questions.question: What do these signs show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. These object markers warn you about dangerous objects or areas to avoid.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead is a divided highway. Keep to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Work area signs are orange with black lettering or symbols. Detour signs show you an alternate route around a road that is blocked by construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They display rules you must follow. Large trucks are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: A yellow panel with "Exit only" on a highway sign means your lane will not go through the interchange. Instead, it will exit onto a ramp. If you are under an "Exit only" sign, you can change lanes to continue through the interchange, or you must exit the highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that the shoulder of the road ahead is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces that are reserved only for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells you that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must keep to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that the road ahead will curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about construction zones. Construction zones are dangerous for both drivers and workers. This sign tells you that the right lane ahead will be closed due to construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at an intersection where you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a traffic regulation rule that you must follow. It tells you that drivers from both directions can use the shared center lane only for left turns. Do not use this lane for regular driving.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. This hand signal means the driver plans to:
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand downward, they are signaling that they plan to stop. If you are following this driver, adjust your speed and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a roundabout is ahead. Enter the roundabout at a slow speed and let existing traffic go first.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are becoming one. You need to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and diamond-shaped. This sign alerts you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that parking is limited. You can only park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that farm machinery may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers of construction zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drive carefully where pedestrians may cross.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns that deer may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves right and then left. Slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right. Slow down to the speed shown.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the speed shown.
Merge. Slow down to the speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right. Slow down to the speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves right. The number shows the safe speed for the curve. In this case, 35 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn of hazards ahead. This sign warns that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Keep your current speed until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Start to slow down your vehicle.
Not slow down because traffic will back up.
Slow down only if you want to.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start to slow down your vehicle.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin slowing down. A new speed limit sign will show the exact speed limit ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing or entering the crosswalk. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn of hazards ahead. This sign warns that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks can use the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead fits only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to safely pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to safely pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn of hazards ahead. This sign warns that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Vertical traffic lights always have red on top and green on bottom. Horizontal traffic lights always have red on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones ahead. This sign tells you that roadwork is starting soon. Slow down and be careful in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means no. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street. You must follow the arrow direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that another road is joining from the right side ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a person is controlling traffic ahead in a construction area. Watch for their signals.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is eight-sided and red. You must come to a complete stop. Check for people and vehicles crossing. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: HOV lanes are reserved for high occupancy vehicles. Only vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers can use this lane. Check the sign for the exact requirement.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to watch for buggies on the road ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Slow down and watch carefully for their safety.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit sign show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower if conditions are not ideal, such as bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed. You must follow this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a playground is near. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange. This sign warns you that road work is happening ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through the work area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic flows in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there are three or more curves coming up on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road curves right first, then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. Do not make a U-turn where you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park here at any time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you the road becomes very slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It is posted at traffic lights where you are not allowed to turn right when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers they can either turn left or go straight ahead from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It tells you the road ahead has loose gravel. Drive carefully because your tires will not grip the road as well as usual.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign with a red circle and red line through it. This means right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with a traffic signal. It tells drivers turning left on a green light that they do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, the driver is signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you see this hand signal.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that railroad tracks are ahead. Slow down when you approach the crossing. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must let them pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a yield sign is ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?

questions.question: What is the main concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may go out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if the shoulder has water on it.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This could cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign alerts drivers to a nearby fire station and warns them to watch for emergency vehicles on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of upcoming railroad crossings. This sign tells drivers they are approaching a railroad crossing and should look for oncoming trains.

options.text: You must travel at exactly the speed shown.

You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
